terms.gloss: the sound a phone makes when it rings
terms.comment: No reference work has a word for a ringtone. The phone rings with sonāre (see the phone is ringing; Andresian p. 14), so the sound it rings with is its sonus, the plain classical word for a sound; sonus tēlephōnī where it must be said whose.

terms.register: vōx poētica: Verg., Ov.; in ōrātiōne solūtā post Augustum (Sen., Plin.)
terms.comment: Classically the ring of bronze and cymbals, so apt for a bell-like tone.

sources: Lewis & Short: sonus · Lewis & Short: tinnitus
Anna Andresian, Vocabula Picta (2014), p. 14: sonō for a ringing phone.
No source has a word for a ringtone.
